boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors immediately around UCF’s main campus, each with one source-backed reason to stop or orient yourself there.

cards.title: UCF Health East Orlando
cards.subtitle: Quadrangle Boulevard corridor, facing University Boulevard
cards.notes: Use this UCF Health site as an orientation point for the Quadrangle Boulevard corridor; its official page places it blocks from main campus facing University Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A university health facility positioned on the University Boulevard-facing edge of Quadrangle Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Health states that its East Orlando facility is on Quadrangle Boulevard, just blocks from UCF’s main campus, facing University Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Tour Our Facilities | Orlando | UCF Health
cards.access_notes: Clinical access and appointment requirements are not stated on this location page; confirm directly with UCF Health before visiting.

cards.title: Chipotle U of Central Florida
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor near Arden Villas Boulevard
cards.notes: Follow University Boulevard to the restaurant’s listed address near Arden Villas Boulevard when you want a customizable burrito, bowl, taco, salad, or quesadilla meal.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard restaurant with a menu built around customizable fast-casual entrées.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its U of Central Florida restaurant at 11680 University Blvd, near University Blvd and Arden Villas Blvd, and describes burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos, and salads.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill in Orlando, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours and ordering options are listed on the location page; check it before making a special trip.

cards.title: The Celeste Hotel
cards.subtitle: North Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Alafaya Trail address as a landmark when arranging a visitor meeting point or exploring the corridor beyond the campus’s eastern edge.
cards.short_summary: A named UCF-area hotel destination on North Alafaya Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF Athletics lists The Celeste at 4105 N Alafaya Trail in Orlando.
cards.source_title: Visiting UCF: Champions Play at UCF
cards.access_notes: Hotel and restaurant services may have separate availability; contact the property for current visitor arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.title: Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.subtitle: North Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use the organization’s own directions page to locate this named community destination at 3144 North Alafaya Trail and confirm an event before attending.
cards.short_summary: A Jewish campus-community destination with a published North Alafaya Trail address.
cards.evidence_claim: Chabad at UCF’s directions page lists its address as 3144 N Alafaya Trail, Orlando, FL 32826.
cards.source_title: Directions - Chabad at University of Central Florida
cards.access_notes: Programming and visitor arrangements are not specified on the directions page; contact Chabad at UCF before attending.

cards.title: Boardwalk at Alafaya Trail
cards.subtitle: Alafaya Trail corridor via Boardwalk Drive
cards.notes: Use this named residential destination to understand the Alafaya Trail edge of campus; the property identifies itself as less than one mile from UCF.
cards.short_summary: A named off-campus residential destination immediately off the Alafaya Trail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Boardwalk at Alafaya Trail states that it is located less than one mile from UCF in Orlando, right off Alafaya Trail.
cards.access_notes: This is a residential property; arrange leasing or visitor access directly with its management.

cards.title: The Pointe at Central
cards.subtitle: Alafaya Trail corridor near University Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the property’s neighborhood page to place this named destination between Alafaya Trail and University Boulevard while mapping the campus-adjacent commercial area.
cards.short_summary: A named residential destination near the Alafaya Trail and University Boulevard connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pointe at Central says it is near Alafaya Trail and a short distance from University Blvd and Alafaya Village & Commons.
cards.access_notes: This is a residential property; arrange leasing or visitor access directly with its management.

cards.title: Partnership III
cards.subtitle: Technology Parkway corridor in Central Florida Research Park
cards.notes: Navigate to Partnership III for the UCF Institute for Simulation and Training’s Synthetic Reality Lab; UCF provides its address and transport guidance from main campus.
cards.short_summary: A UCF research destination in the Technology Parkway section of Central Florida Research Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF’s Synthetic Reality Lab says it is inside Partnership III at 3039 Technology Pkwy and describes it as south of UCF Main Campus.
cards.access_notes: This is an academic research facility; confirm public access or any scheduled activity with the lab before visiting.

cards.title: UCF Communication Disorders Clinic
cards.subtitle: Progress Drive corridor in Central Florida Research Park
cards.notes: Use the clinic’s published Progress Drive address when navigating the research-park corridor; schedule or contact the clinic before seeking clinical services.
cards.short_summary: A UCF clinical destination at the Progress Drive entrance to Central Florida Research Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that its Communication Disorders Clinic is in the Innovative Center at 3280 Progress Drive in Central Florida Research Park.
cards.source_title: UCF Communication Disorders Clinic information packet
cards.access_notes: Clinical services require advance coordination; use the clinic’s contact information to confirm current appointment procedures.

cards.title: Blanchard Park
cards.subtitle: North Dean Road corridor
cards.notes: Head to the North Dean Road entrance for an Orange County park with trails, picnic areas, courts, a playground, and the Little Econ Greenway running through it.
cards.short_summary: An 84-acre county park where the Little Econ Greenway and river pass through the site.
cards.evidence_claim: Orange County lists Blanchard Park at 2451 N Dean Rd and identifies trails, courts, picnic areas, a playground, and the 7.4-mile Little Econ Greenway Trail.
cards.access_notes: Orange County lists summer hours of 8 a.m.–8 p.m. and winter hours of 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; rental pavilions require separate arrangements.

cards.title: Alafaya Commons
cards.subtitle: East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail corridor
cards.notes: Use this named retail center to orient yourself at the East Colonial Drive–Alafaya Trail junction; its property page identifies a direct Alafaya Trail connection to UCF.
cards.short_summary: A named commercial destination at the East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Alafaya Commons is listed at 11841–11931 E Colonial Drive, at the intersection of East Colonial Drive and Alafaya Trail, with a direct connection to UCF via Alafaya Trail.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own access rules and hours; verify the destination you intend to visit before traveling.
